newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan court to try fisherman over 26 missing people.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan court to try fisherman over 26 missing people.

text.p: A Moroccan fisherman will appear before a criminal court next week charged with being responsible for the death of 26 immigrants who tried illegally to enter Spain, the official MAP news agency said on Saturday.

Abdelaziz Fellah Boughaba, 27, was arrested on Monday after he told police his small boat sank in the Strait of Gibralter while trying to reach the southern Spanish coast with 26 people on board. The accident took place on Sunday, the agency said.
Boughaba managed to swim ashore but the 26 immigrants who were on board with him are still missing, MAP said.
A court prosecutor questioned the fisherman on Friday, the agency added.
Contacted by telephone, police at the northern city of Tangier declined to comment on the issue.
The local press often reports cases of young people drowning in the Strait of Gibraltar, including jobless black Africans, as they try to reach the richer northern shore of the Mediterranean.
